name: BILL Spend & Expense
summary: BILL Spend & Expense issues physical and virtual cards with limits assigned per card, and syncs with NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, Microsoft and Xero. The pricing page lists the plan at $0 per user each month, with standard card and payment fees where they apply.

facts.text: On the product page, physical or virtual cards can be created for teams, with limits and rules, and for specific teams or projects.
The FAQ says administrators can create custom business budgets, assign card limits and automate approval workflows.
Accounting sync is named for NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, Microsoft and Xero, run automatically or on demand.
Pricing FAQ: there are no per-user subscription fees for BILL Spend & Expense, and standard card and payment fees apply where applicable.
BILL's security page says it undergoes an annual SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type II audit by a national CPA firm.

plans.name: Spend & Expense
plans.notes: Standard card and payment fees apply where applicable. The product page says pricing is based on business needs and the number of users

hiddenCosts: Standard card and payment fees apply on top of the plan, and the card page does not list physical card fees.
Pay-by-card payments are listed at 2.9% in the payment fee table.

contract.cancellation: The terms say an account can be canceled at any time, and for subscription accounts the cancellation takes effect on the last day of the current billing cycle.
